authority.role: project owner and final decision authority

appliesTo: object versus rule versus effect classification
bounded balancing recommendations where source values are incomplete
scope.process: For every unresolved item, generate the best evidence-based recommendation, record its rationale and provenance, and adopt that recommendation without requesting case-by-case owner confirmation.

decisionRules: Prefer explicit source text over inference.
Prefer repository governance and canonical templates over ad hoc interpretation.
Use neighboring entries and cross-source consistency only when direct evidence is incomplete.
Choose the least destructive and most reversible interpretation when multiple options remain plausible.
Preserve raw source values and the rejected alternatives in audit evidence.
Never fabricate citations, source facts, identifiers, or relationships.
Do not assign canonical identity or promotion readiness until required validation gates pass.
Escalate only when the decision changes product scope, contradicts an existing owner decision, creates legal or safety risk, or cannot be made without inventing unsupported facts.
